notes: Domain-level governance policy consumed by tools/generate_governance_narrative.py: which domains are excluded from aggregate scoring, which are flagged as passive-inheritance risk, and fixed editorial guidance text tied to specific domains or always rendered in the findings section. Values here reproduce the generator's own pre-externalization Python literals exactly (see docs/governance_evidence_package.md) -- this profile does not change any classification output by itself.

domain_guidance.phases: Templates are internally consistent on phases but projects carry phases not defined in templates — project teams are adding project-specific phases.
domain_guidance.loaded_family_types: Family loading is inherently project-specific. Template governance establishes a floor, not a ceiling. Consider approved-list governance rather than full vocabulary convergence.

static_findings_guidance: Loaded family types and materials should not be governed like object styles. These domains are often project-specific. Review them for approved lists, starter content, exception rules, or documentation rather than full vocabulary convergence.
